    Our Process

    01

    Consultation & Site Visit

    Free site assessment, requirement analysis, and initial budget discussion.

    1-2 Days
    02

    Design & 3D Presentation

    Architectural planning, Vastu compliance, and 3D walkthrough of your dream home.

    7-10 Days
    03

    Detailed BOQ & Agreement

    Transparent cost breakup with material specifications and payment schedule.

    3-5 Days
    04

    Material Procurement

    Premium quality materials from branded suppliers with GST invoices.

    5-7 Days
    05

    Construction Phase

    Quality execution with weekly progress reports and site photos.

    3-12 Months
    06

    Quality Check & Handover

    Third-party quality audit, snag list resolution, and final handover.

    7-10 Days
